mainEntity.name: What makes the BabeFit Program different from other fitness classes?

acceptedAnswer.text: The BabeFit Program distinguishes itself by being a women-specific functional fitness program, fostering a supportive community while delivering challenging workouts. Unlike general gym classes, it focuses on functional movements that improve real-world strength and mobility within a structured curriculum. A practical tradeoff is that while it offers specialized coaching for women, it might not suit those preferring a mixed-gender training environment or a less structured approach.
